We only support these rule types: amount_cap (A single refund may not be larger than a fixed dollar amount); approval_required (A refund needs an earlier approval, given within a time window, for at least the refund amount); capped_with_approval (Refunds for one specific order are capped at a dollar amount and also need an approval); deploy_allowlist (Only the listed services may be deployed); deploy_needs_tests (A service version may only be deployed if its tests passed within a time window).
